CollectionItemUpdateRequest.description:
Partial update. Every field is optional; omitted fields are untouched.

`status` is how an item is retired: setting it to `finished` or `sold`
preserves the wear history that a hard delete would destroy.
CollectionItemUpdateRequest.title: CollectionItemUpdateRequest

FragranceCreateRequest.description:
A private custom fragrance.

Brand, name and concentration are required; the descriptive and
classification metadata a curated entry carries is optional here, and
insights report what is missing rather than guessing.
FragranceCreateRequest.title: FragranceCreateRequest

MeUpdateRequest.description: Only the display name is writable; email is owned by the provider.
MeUpdateRequest.title: MeUpdateRequest

PreferencesUpdateRequest.description: A full replacement of the preference set; omitted fields clear.
PreferencesUpdateRequest.title: PreferencesUpdateRequest

Phase one: mark the account pending.

The caller deletes the provider identity next; the provider's signed
webhook then drives the actual data removal.
Roll back the pending mark when the provider deletion call failed.
